notes.title: 2.1.0 Update: Jam Cave and Stats
notes.notes:
Yo! It's been one year since Floaty Fighters was released so here's a small update!

New Stage - Jam Cave
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665675/1c0d260f13f6fcc23d83f7b1024c3324b5553950.png
Back in May we released the 5th character Sotz, and now we're releasing her stage with her theme! The speakers and green stalactites act as walls that you can use to block attacks or get away from an opponent.

Stats Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665675/06e12194e449b89bf70a7dc001711a678c15f874.png
Now you can view your stats for each character, and see which skins you've unlocked! A good way to keep track of how much floating and fighting you're truly doing.

Here's the small stuff, thanks for floating!

 Escape doesn't work as forward, but now both enters do. All of them will pause the game
 Some headers have been changed to use the proper header font
 Bunny's small firework small damage buff
 Sotz sonic wave cooldown made slightly longer
 Alpha's boot blast causes less screen-shake

notes.title: 1.1.1 Update: Golden Experience
notes.notes:
Yo! It's the first update for Floaty Fighters! There are two big things, and then you can read a list of all the small things.

The graphics have been improved! Here's a video of some new gameplay:

[previewyoutube=dGvT_bRCWsg;full][/previewyoutube]

There are now unlockables in Floaty! This includes some skins that used to be given out at the start and two of the stages. Now you'll have to unlock them through either special means or just playing the game a lot. There's also new gold skins you can unlock for every character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665675/44a2d79bf85c339094456b10f687479faeb5df07.png

Here's the whole list:

Major
 Graphics improved.
 Unlockable skins added.
 Strafing added on the shoulder buttons.


Minor
 Can scroll through skins faster.
 Sliders for volumes can be changed by 10% instead of 20%.
 Chaoitc Portal stage's music is louder.
 Various bugs fixed.


Cumulo
 Cumulo's wind is only near them when spawned instead of taking up the whole screen.
 Getting damp is not a bubble anymore, it's an overlay effect over the character.
 Small graphical glitch fixed with the bottom of clouds when shocked for some skins.


Bunny
 Wand comes back instantly after hitting chaos storm.


Phoenix
 Fire is now a separate effect when applied to feathers.
